items.stem: Deal sponsors justify a high price mainly by large projected revenue synergies. What is the most prudent corporate-development stance?

options.text: Treat revenue synergies as the least reliable value and avoid paying for them upfront
options.rationale: Correct: revenue synergies are notoriously hard to realise and should not be prepaid into the price.

options.text: Revenue synergies are the most certain source of value
options.rationale: They are generally the least certain.
Reliable cost synergies legitimately inform value.

options.text: Paying for projected synergies always improves returns
options.rationale: Overpaying for uncertain synergies destroys value.

items.explanation: Correct: revenue synergies are notoriously hard to realise and should not be prepaid into the price.

items.stem: Which TWO practices most improve the odds that an acquisition creates value? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Setting and respecting a disciplined walk-away price
options.rationale: Correct: walk-away discipline prevents value-destroying overpayment.

options.text: Planning integration before the deal closes
options.rationale: Correct: early integration planning is strongly linked to realised value.

options.text: Winning the deal regardless of price to avoid losing to a rival
options.rationale: Winning at any price destroys value.

options.text: Deferring all integration thinking until a year after close
options.rationale: Late integration loses momentum and value.

options.text: Hiding diligence findings from the board

items.explanation: Correct: walk-away discipline prevents value-destroying overpayment.

items.stem: Post-close, an acquirer leaves the target entirely alone for 18 months 'to avoid disruption'. What is the most likely consequence?

options.text: The planned synergies and strategic rationale go largely unrealised
options.rationale: Correct: value from most deals requires active, timely integration, not indefinite autonomy.

options.text: Value is automatically preserved by non-interference
Integration is unnecessary if the target is profitable
options.rationale: Standalone profit does not deliver the deal thesis.
